notes: No official validation split in this source (train/test only) — a val split must be carved from train at Stage 4/5, consistent with CLAUDE.md's note that Kermany's official val split is unusably small anyway.

Normal-class filenames do not carry a patient identifier (only pneumonia-class filenames do, as 'personNNN_bacteria/virus_NNN.jpeg') — patient-level grouping is only partially possible for this dataset (ADR-7 limitation).
